Home.headline: Inspect a used-car listing before you go see it.
Home.intro: Start with the listing URL. Kontroll separates claims, open checks, and evidence.

Submission.label: Listing URL
Submission.explanation: Report access is saved privately in this browser. The page address alone does not grant access.
Submission.invalidUrl: Enter a secure listing URL beginning with https://.
Submission.requestFailed: The analysis could not be started. Try again.
Submission.pastedHint: Paste the seller's listing text when the page cannot be read. Labeled facts such as Make: and Year: help identify the car.
Submission.fallbackDescription: Start the analysis, then add the pasted description and screenshots.
Submission.inspectionWaiting: Waiting for a complete HTTPS listing address.
Submission.inspectionAuto24: Auto24 recognized. The listing is ready for automatic capture.
Submission.inspectionFallback: HTTPS accepted. Description and screenshots may be needed.
Submission.inspectionInvalid: This address cannot be inspected. Use a complete HTTPS address.
Submission.manualTitle: Create a report from your information
Submission.manualIntro: Paste the listing text. After opening the private report, you can add screenshots and seller replies. The listing will not be fetched.

offline.localOnly: Local report saved; offline reload unavailable
offline.stale: This is the last saved report. New checks are unavailable until you reconnect.
offline.clearFailed: Could not confirm the offline copy was fully removed. Try again.
offline.missing: No local copy of this report is available. Connect to the internet and open the private report again.

access.heading: Opening the inspection report
access.deniedExplanation: Open the original private report link to view this analysis.
access.explanation: Keep this page open while the private access link is checked. If it does not open, reload the original link.
access.unavailableExplanation: Reload this private link to try again.

status.partial: Initial report ready; further checks are running

Report.confidencePending: Recommendations appear after the evidence review is complete.

findings.heading: Still needs checking
findings.intro: Resolve these points before agreeing to travel, pay a deposit, or buy.
findings.empty: No unresolved checks are present in the current report.
findings.waiting: Checks will appear after the initial information has been processed.

seller.heading: Message the seller
seller.intro: Send one focused request before arranging the viewing.
seller.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select all text in the field below and copy it manually.

checklist.heading: At the viewing
checklist.intro: Tick these off while you inspect and test-drive the car.

supplement.heading: Add seller information
supplement.intro: Add seller answers, maintenance documents, or extra images. PDF files are stored privately but their contents are not analyzed. All supplied material remains unverified.
supplement.filesHint: Add up to eight JPEG, PNG, WebP, or PDF files.
supplement.success: Information added. The report is updating.
supplement.updated: Information added. The report is up to date.
supplement.updateFailed: Information added, but the report could not be updated.
supplement.invalid: Add an answer or at least one file.
supplement.tooManyFiles: Add no more than eight files.
supplement.failed: The information could not be added. Try again.

review.heading: Evidence review

state.pending: Waiting to review the supplied information.
state.running: Reviewing the supplied text and images. Initial checks remain visible.
state.incomplete: AI review is incomplete. Initial checks remain available.
state.disabled: AI review is disabled. This report contains initial checks only.
state.complete: The supplied information has been reviewed. Seller material remains unverified.

review.retryFailed: Could not restart the review. Try again.

compact.counts: {findings, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} · {photos, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}
compact.methodology: Findings retain their original descriptions and evidence. Listing and seller claims remain unverified unless corroborated; photos cannot establish the full condition of a vehicle.
compact.photoLimitations: Seller and listing claims remain unverified unless corroborated. Photo review does not replace an in-person inspection.
